title: Smaller Diophantine forms of ZFC consistency
theorem: ZFC proves: no strictly positive solution of the supplied fixed-instance polynomial iff Con(ZFC).
operation_convention: Binary +,-,* including squares and fixed-numeral multiplication; shared registers, fixed coefficients, and equality comparisons free.
system_comparison_qualification: The earlier package21 system also uses111 operations after direct final comparison; the improvement is degree at tied normalized cost.
proof_status: New ordinary mathematical proofs plus explicitly identified inherited native-compiler and K215 dependencies; no new end-to-end Lean/Rocq certificate.
not_claimed: improved variable count over the existing nine-natural-variable form
